NE.summary:
- **A.J. Brown (WR)** — is being framed as New England’s true alpha X-receiver, the featured outside role this offense has lacked. That’s the clearest usage win in the receiver room and makes him the strongest target bet from the Patriots’ camp notes [2].

- **Jeremiah Franklin (TE)** — was officially signed as the Patriots added yet another body to a now seven-deep tight end room. That doesn’t create immediate fantasy value, but it does add more competition behind Henry and Raridon [4].
